summary: Chilean Cobalt Corp. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01 Other Events) reporting that the Export-Import Bank of the United States would not renew an expired Letter of Interest after a permitted single 12-month extension. The company submitted a new application for an LOI with substantially similar terms and expects ordinary-course processing. This filing involves a routine financing update without any merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or other special-situation event. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics to analyze, making this a routine disclosure of a non-material operational matter.
